result.explanation: Track each begun job, its phase, and its owned resources. A begin is atomic and does not consume an ID when blocked. Prepare, commit, and abort enforce the required phase transitions; terminal jobs remain recorded so IDs cannot be reused. Ownership is released on commit or abort, and output exposes only configured held resources plus sorted committed IDs.
result.program: function solve(x){var c=x.config,e=x.event,s=x.state;if(s==null)s={j:{},h:{},d:[]};else{var j0=s.j||{},h0=s.h||{},d0=s.d||[];s={j:{},h:Object.assign({},h0),d:d0.slice()};for(var q in j0){s.j[q]={p:j0[q].p,r:(j0[q].r||[]).slice()}}}var id=e.id,st="invalid",j;if(e.type==="begin"){var ok=!Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(s.j,id);if(ok)for(var i=0;i<e.resources.length;i++)if(Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(s.h,e.resources[i])){ok=false;break}if(ok){s.j[id]={p:"active",r:e.resources.slice()};for(i=0;i<e.resources.length;i++)s.h[e.resources[i]]=id;st="begun"}else st="blocked"}else if(Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(s.j,id)){j=s.j[id];if(e.type==="prepare"&&j.p==="active"){j.p="prepared";st="prepared"}else if(e.type==="commit"&&j.p==="prepared"){j.p="committed";for(var k=0;k<j.r.length;k++)delete s.h[j.r[k]];s.d.push(id);s.d.sort();st="committed"}else if(e.type==="abort"&&(j.p==="active"||j.p==="prepared")){j.p="aborted";for(var z=0;z<j.r.length;z++)delete s.h[j.r[z]];st="aborted"}}var held={};for(var a=0;a<c.resources.length;a++){var r=c.resources[a];if(Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(s.h,r))held[r]=s.h[r]}return{state:s,output:{status:st,held:held,done:s.d.slice()}}}
